Hold the position, breathe normally.

Push the knee back to fully straight against the band, squeeze 2 s.

Step down slowly with the other leg.

Lower slowly, toes pointing forward.

Hinge forward, the free leg going back, back flat.
Return to standing by squeezing the glute.

lines: Hold a stick along your spine touching head, upper back and tailbone.
Push the hips back, keeping all 3 contact points.
Return by driving hips forward.

title: Slider hamstring curl

lines: Lie on your back, heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift hips into a bridge.
Slide the heels out slowly, then pull them back in.

lines: Kneel with a partner holding your ankles.
Lower your body forward as slowly as possible, hips straight.
Catch yourself with your hands, push back up.

Dig the heel into the floor at low effort (30–50%).
Hold, then relax.

title: Running strides

lines: Run 60–80 m, building up gradually.
Reach the target speed in the middle third.
Walk back to recover.

title: Walk–jog intervals
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="124.1" y1="59.4" x2="118.4" y2="85.8" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118.4" y1="85.8" x2="141.4" y2="100" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="111.2" y2="140.4" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="111.2" y1="140.4" x2="98.7" y2="174.1" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="98.7" y1="174.1" x2="110.7" y2="174.1" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="124.7" y2="55.5" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="126.2" cy="44.6" r="10"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="133" y2="137.9" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="133" y1="137.9" x2="141.3" y2="173" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="141.3" y1="173" x2="152.6" y2="177.1" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124.1" y1="59.4" x2="101.7" y2="74.5" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="101.7" y1="74.5" x2="110.6" y2="100" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Each pain-free session, add jog time.
Target 20–30 min continuous easy running.

Low resistance.
Steady pedalling.

Keep posture tall and arms swinging.

Stay on the balls of the feet.
Land quietly.

lines: Step off a low box (20–30 cm).
Land on both feet softly, hips back, knees over toes.
Hold the landing 2 s.

lines: Jump sideways from one leg to the other.
Land and stick for 2 s before the next.
Increase distance gradually.

Shift forward gently.

Drive one knee towards the chest, then switch.
Keep hips low and steady.

Slowly nod down and up, then turn left and right.
Move in a comfortable range.

Step through gently until you feel the chest stretch.
Hold, then switch sides.

Lift the straight leg until you feel a stretch.
Hold, relaxing the leg.

Make slow circles forward, then backward.
Grow the circles gradually.

title: Single-leg squat to box
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="62" y="142" width="40" height="34" rx="2"/><line x1="122.6" y1="86.1" x2="137.4" y2="108.7" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="137.4" y1="108.7" x2="152" y2="86" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="126" x2="140.5" y2="115.3" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="140.5" y1="115.3" x2="150" y2="150" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="150" x2="162" y2="150" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="126" x2="124.3" y2="82.5" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="128.9" cy="72.5" r="10"/><line x1="104" y1="126" x2="137.7" y2="143.6" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="137.7" y1="143.6" x2="122" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="176" x2="134" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122.6" y1="86.1" x2="139.4" y2="107.3" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="139.4" y1="107.3" x2="156" y2="86" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Stand up on the same leg, knee in line with the 2nd toe.

Lower slowly.

Walk 10–20 m.

Pull the heel towards your bottom, keeping the knees together.

Straighten the knee while lifting the head to look up.
Bend the knee while dropping the chin. Move slowly in rhythm.

lines: Sit on a chair, hands behind your head.
Gently arch the upper back over the chair back, looking up.
Return to upright.

title: Scalp massage
lines: Place your fingertips (not nails) on the scalp.
Press firmly and move the skin in small circles — do not just rub the hair.
Work from the front hairline to the crown, the sides and the back of the head.

title: Neck & upper-shoulder release
sub: Tension around the head and neck
lines: Sit tall and drop your shoulders.
Tilt your ear towards one shoulder and hold.
Gently press the tight muscle at the top of the shoulder with the other hand. Switch sides.

title: Cheek lifter
lines: Open your mouth into a long "O", lips covering the teeth.
Smile with the upper cheeks to lift them up.
Place your fingers lightly on the cheeks and hold, then relax.

title: Jaw relax & open
lines: Rest the tip of your tongue behind the top teeth.
Slowly open your mouth as far as is comfortable, keeping the tongue there.
Close slowly. Then massage the jaw muscle in front of the ear in circles.

title: Forehead smoother
lines: Place your fingertips flat on the forehead.
Gently glide them out towards the temples, smoothing the skin.
Relax the eyebrows completely between strokes.

title: Chin & neck lift
lines: Sit tall and look up towards the ceiling.
Push your lower lip over the upper lip (or press the tongue to the roof of the mouth).
Feel the front of the neck work. Hold, then return slowly.

title: Smile hold
lines: Smile widely with the lips closed.
Pull the corners of the mouth up and back. Hold.
Relax fully, then repeat.

title: Near–far focus
lines: Hold your thumb about 25 cm in front of your face.
Focus on it for a few seconds.
Then focus on something far away (6 m or more). Switch back and forth.

title: Eye movements
lines: Keep your head still.
Look up, down, left and right slowly, pausing at each end.
Then draw slow circles with your eyes, both directions.

title: Palming
lines: Rub your palms together to warm them.
Cup them over your closed eyes without pressing.
Breathe slowly and enjoy the darkness.

title: Belly breathing
lines: Sit or lie comfortably, one hand on the chest, one on the belly.
Breathe in through the nose for 4 seconds — only the belly hand rises.
Breathe out slowly through the mouth for 6 seconds.

title: Box breathing
lines: Breathe in through the nose for 4 seconds.
Hold for 4 seconds.
Breathe out for 4 seconds, then hold for 4 seconds. Repeat.

title: Pelvic floor squeeze (Kegel)
lines: Sit or lie comfortably. Find the muscles you would use to stop passing urine and wind.
Squeeze and lift them inwards. Hold for the count, breathing normally.
Relax fully for the same time. Then do 10 quick squeezes.

title: Finger spread & squeeze
lines: Make a tight fist and hold for 2 seconds.
Open and spread the fingers as wide as you can.
Touch each fingertip to the thumb in turn.

title: Wrist circles & stretch
lines: Make slow circles with both wrists, 10 each way.
Hold one arm straight, palm up, and gently pull the fingers back.
Then palm down and pull the hand down. Switch arms.

title: Toe spread & lift
lines: Sit with bare feet flat on the floor.
Spread all your toes as wide as possible and hold.
Relax, then lift all toes up while the ball of the foot stays down.

title: Knee push-up
lines: Kneel with hands under the shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower the chest towards the floor, then push back up.

title: Pike push-up
lines: Start in a push-up position and walk your feet in so the hips go up into an upside-down V.
Bend the elbows and lower the top of the head towards the floor.
Push back up.

title: Chair dip
lines: Sit on the edge of a stable chair, hands next to your hips.
Slide your bottom off the chair, knees bent.
Bend the elbows to lower yourself a little, then push back up.

title: Sumo squat
lines: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out.
Sit down between your heels with the chest up.
Push through the heels to stand and squeeze the glutes.

title: Fire hydrant
lines: On hands and knees, back flat.
Lift one bent knee out to the side to hip height.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch sides.

title: High knees
lines: Run on the spot, lifting the knees to hip height.
Land softly on the balls of the feet.
Pump the arms.

title: Burpee
lines: Squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Step or jump the feet back to a plank, then bring them back in.
Stand up and reach the arms overhead (add a small jump if you can).

title: Lying leg raise
lines: Lie on your back, hands under your lower back or by your sides.
Keep the low back pressed down and lift both legs up.
Lower them slowly without the back arching.

title: Water-bottle shoulder press
lines: Hold two filled water bottles (or a light backpack) at shoulder height.
Brace your stomach and press them straight up.
Lower slowly back to the shoulders.

title: Backpack row
lines: Put books or water bottles in a backpack and hold it by the top handle.
Hinge forward with a flat back, the other hand on a chair.
Pull the elbow back towards the hip, then lower slowly.

title: Band shoulder press
lines: Stand on the middle of a band, ends in your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight up.
Lower slowly against the band.

title: Step jacks (no jumping)
lines: Stand tall, arms by your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising both arms overhead.
Step back in and repeat on the other side. Keep a quick rhythm.

title: Step-back burpee (no jump)
lines: Squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Step one foot back, then the other, into a plank.
Step the feet back in and stand up tall.

title: Scalp kneading
lines: Spread your fingers and press the pads firmly on the scalp.
Without sliding, push the skin forward and back, then side to side.
Move your hands to a new spot every few seconds until you have covered the whole head.

title: Temple & hairline circles
lines: Place two or three fingertips on each temple.
Make slow, firm circles for 20 seconds.
Move along the hairline to the middle of the forehead and repeat.

title: Fingertip scalp tapping
lines: Curve your fingers and tap the scalp lightly and quickly with the fingertips.
Start at the hairline and work back to the base of the skull.
Keep it gentle — like light rain, not knocking.

title: Alternate-nostril breathing
lines: Sit tall. Close the right nostril with your thumb and breathe in through the left for 4 counts.
Close the left nostril with your ring finger, open the right and breathe out for 6 counts.
Breathe in through the right, switch, breathe out through the left. Repeat slowly.

title: Legs up the wall
lines: Sit sideways next to a wall, then lie back and swing your legs up the wall.
Rest your arms by your sides and let your shoulders drop.
Breathe slowly through your nose.

title: Downward dog
lines: Start on hands and knees.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back into an upside-down V.
Keep the knees soft and press the floor away with your hands.

title: Standing forward fold
lines: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Fold forward from the hips and let your head and arms hang.
Breathe slowly, then roll up one vertebra at a time.

title: Wall posture check
lines: Stand with heels, buttocks, shoulder blades and the back of your head touching a wall.
Tuck your chin slightly and lengthen the back of the neck.
Breathe normally and remember this feeling, then step away and keep it.

title: Dead hang
lines: Grip a sturdy bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet or bend your knees and hang with straight arms.
Breathe slowly. Step down before your grip fails.

title: Tall overhead reach
lines: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead as high as you can, rising onto your toes.
Hold for a slow breath, then lower and reach to each side.

Qaytadan to‘g‘ri holatga sirpantiring.

lines: Yuz bilan pastga yoting, tizza qopqog‘i karavot chetidan biroz chiqib tursin.
Og‘irlik kuchi tizzani to‘g‘rilasin.
Sonni to‘liq bo‘shashtiring.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="86.9" y1="123" x2="105.2" y2="142.7" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="105.2" y1="142.7" x2="126.9" y2="158.8" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="166" x2="133.6" y2="160.4" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="133.6" y1="160.4" x2="168" y2="171" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="168" y1="171" x2="168" y2="159" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="166" x2="86" y2="119" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="83.7" cy="108.3" r="10"/><line x1="96" y1="166" x2="134" y2="164.2" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="134" y1="164.2" x2="169.6" y2="169" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="169.6" y1="169" x2="169.6" y2="157" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="86.9" y1="123" x2="106" y2="142" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="106" y1="142" x2="128.3" y2="157.3" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Oyoq to‘g‘ri, son bo‘shashgan holda o‘tiring.
Barmoqlar bilan tizza qopqog‘ini yumshoq yuqoriga, pastga, ichkariga va tashqariga suring.
Har yo‘nalishda bir necha soniya ushlang.

lines: Oyoqlar son kengligida, kerak bo‘lsa tayanchni ushlang.
Baland stulga o‘tirayotgandek biroz orqaga o‘tiring, tizzalar taxminan 45°.
Ikkala tovon bilan itarib turing.

title: Devorga suyanib o‘tirish

lines: Bel devorga, og‘riqsiz tizza burchagigacha pastga sirpaning.
Og‘irlik tovonlarda.
Holatni ushlab turing, normal nafas oling.

title: Ispancha cho‘kkalash
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="210" y="80" width="7" height="96"/><line x1="90.1" y1="97.6" x2="117" y2="99.7" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="117" y1="99.7" x2="143.8" y2="96.3" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="84" y1="141.2" x2="122" y2="140.2" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="140.2" x2="118" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="176" x2="130" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="84" y1="141.2" x2="90.7" y2="93.7" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="92.2" cy="82.8" r="10"/><line x1="84" y1="141.2" x2="122" y2="140" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="140" x2="122" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="176" x2="134" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="90.1" y1="97.6" x2="117" y2="99.7" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="117" y1="99.7" x2="143.9" y2="96.7" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line class="band" x1="210" y1="128" x2="122" y2="140" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg>
lines: Kuchli rezinani ikki tizza orqasidan o‘tkazib, ustunga mahkamlang.
Rezinaga suyanib, boldirlar tik bo‘lguncha o‘tiring.
Ko‘krak tik holda ushlab turing.

title: Tizzani oxirigacha yozish
sub: Ichki keng mushak, yozilishning oxirgi gradusi
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="206" y="100" width="7" height="76"/><line x1="118" y1="59" x2="111.9" y2="85.3" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="111.9" y1="85.3" x2="116" y2="112" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="124.1" y2="140.5" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124.1" y1="140.5" x2="118" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="176" x2="130" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="118" y2="55" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="118" cy="44" r="10"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="126.3" y2="140.1" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="126.3" y1="140.1" x2="124" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124" y1="176" x2="136" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="59" x2="115.2" y2="85.9" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="115.2" y1="85.9" x2="122" y2="112" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line class="band" x1="206" y1="140" x2="126.3" y2="140.1" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg>
lines: Rezina tizza orqasida, oldinda mahkamlangan.
Tizza biroz bukik holda boshlang.
Rezinaga qarshi tizzani to‘liq to‘g‘rilab orqaga itaring, 2 s siqing.

title: Zinapoyaga chiqish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="132" y="152" width="48" height="24" rx="2"/><line x1="150" y1="36" x2="136.4" y2="59.3" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="136.4" y1="59.3" x2="126.7" y2="84.5" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="80" x2="162.7" y2="115.8" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="162.7" y1="115.8" x2="136" y2="140" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="136" y1="140" x2="148" y2="140" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="80" x2="150" y2="32" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="150" cy="21" r="10"/><line x1="150" y1="80" x2="160.3" y2="116.6" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="160.3" y1="116.6" x2="154" y2="152" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="154" y1="152" x2="166" y2="152" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="36" x2="138.1" y2="60.2" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="138.1" y1="60.2" x2="130.1" y2="86" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Ishlayotgan oyoq bilan chiqib, tik turing.
Ikkinchi oyoq bilan sekin tushing.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="80" y="150" width="50" height="26" rx="2"/><line x1="117.6" y1="64.2" x2="107.3" y2="89.1" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="107.3" y1="89.1" x2="132" y2="100" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="106" x2="124.3" y2="138.1" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124.3" y1="138.1" x2="138.1" y2="171.4" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="138.1" y1="171.4" x2="150.1" y2="171.4" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="106" x2="118.8" y2="60.3" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="122.2" cy="49.9" r="10"/><line x1="104" y1="106" x2="136.5" y2="125.7" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="136.5" y1="125.7" x2="110" y2="150" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="110" y1="150" x2="122" y2="150" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="117.6" y1="64.2" x2="110.8" y2="90.3" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="110.8" y1="90.3" x2="136" y2="100" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Ishlayotgan oyoq bilan zinapoyada turing.
Ikkinchi tovonni oldinda polga tekkizish uchun sekin tushiring.
Tizzani keskin qotirmasdan orqaga itarib ko‘tariling.

title: Split-cho‘kkalash
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="114" y1="96" x2="112.2" y2="122.9" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112.2" y1="122.9" x2="116" y2="149.7" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114" y1="140" x2="116.9" y2="177.9" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116.9" y1="177.9" x2="82" y2="169" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="82" y1="169" x2="91.8" y2="175.9" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114" y1="140" x2="114" y2="92" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="114" cy="81" r="10"/><line x1="114" y1="140" x2="152" y2="140.1" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="152" y1="140.1" x2="150" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="176" x2="162" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114" y1="96" x2="114.1" y2="123" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114.1" y1="123" x2="119.9" y2="149.4" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Uzun qadam holati, orqa tovon ko‘tarilgan.
Orqa tizzani to‘g‘ri pastga, polga tomon tushiring.
Old tovon bilan itarib ko‘tariling.

title: Orqa oyoq ko‘tarilgan split-cho‘kkalash (bolgarcha)

lines: Orqa oyoq orqangizdagi skameykada.
Old oyoqda nazorat bilan pastga tushing.
Old oyoq bilan itarib ko‘tariling.

title: Cho‘kkalash
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="125.2" y1="102" x2="122.7" y2="128.8" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122.7" y1="128.8" x2="142" y2="110" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="138" x2="137" y2="146.7" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="137" y1="146.7" x2="116" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="176" x2="128" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="138" x2="127.5" y2="98.7" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="133.8" cy="89.7" r="10"/><line x1="100" y1="138" x2="137.6" y2="143.6" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="137.6" y1="143.6" x2="122" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="176" x2="134" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="125.2" y1="102" x2="126.7" y2="128.9" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="126.7" y1="128.9" x2="146" y2="110" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Tovonlar orasiga og‘riqsiz chuqurlikkacha o‘tiring.
Dumbani siqib tik turing.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><polygon class="prop" points="104,176 142,176 142,164"/><line x1="122.6" y1="84.1" x2="132.4" y2="109.3" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="132.4" y1="109.3" x2="146" y2="86" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="124" x2="140.5" y2="113.3" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="140.5" y1="113.3" x2="150" y2="148" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="148" x2="162" y2="148" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="124" x2="124.3" y2="80.5" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="128.9" cy="70.5" r="10"/><line x1="104" y1="124" x2="140" y2="136.1" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="140" y1="136.1" x2="120" y2="166" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="166" x2="131.6" y2="163.1" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122.6" y1="84.1" x2="134.7" y2="108.3" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="134.7" y1="108.3" x2="150" y2="86" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Taxminan 60° gacha sekin cho‘kkalang.
Kerak bo‘lsa, ko‘tarilish uchun ikkinchi oyoqdan yordam oling.

Dumbani siqib, sonni to‘g‘ri chiziqqacha ko‘taring.
Sekin tushiring.

Sonni burmasdan tekis ko‘taring.
Sekin tushiring.

Chanoqni orqaga aylantirmasdan ustki tizzani oching.
Sekin tushiring.

lines: Yonboshlab yoting, pastki tizza bukilgan.
To‘g‘ri ustki oyoqni tanadan biroz orqaroqqa ko‘taring.
Barmoqlar oldinga qaragan holda sekin tushiring.

Oldinga bukiling, bo‘sh oyoq orqaga ketadi, bel tekis.
Dumbani siqib tik holatga qayting.

title: Sondan bukilish mashqi
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="141.8" y1="92.4" x2="129.2" y2="116.2" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="129.2" y1="116.2" x2="142" y2="140" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="106" x2="116.9" y2="140" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116.9" y1="140" x2="116" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="176" x2="128" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="106" x2="145.7" y2="91.2" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="156.1" cy="87.8" r="10"/><line x1="100" y1="106" x2="115.9" y2="140.5" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="115.9" y1="140.5" x2="122" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="176" x2="134" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="141.8" y1="92.4" x2="131.4" y2="117.3" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="131.4" y1="117.3" x2="146" y2="140" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Uchala nuqtani saqlab, sonni orqaga suring.
Sonni oldinga itarib qayting.

Sonni ko‘prikka ko‘taring.
Tovonlarni sekin oldinga sirpantiring, keyin qaytarib torting.

Son to‘g‘ri holda tanani iloji boricha sekin oldinga tushiring.
Qo‘llaringiz bilan tutib qolib, orqaga itarib ko‘tariling.

Tovonni past kuch (30–50%) bilan polga bosing.
Ushlab turing, keyin bo‘shating.

Maqsad tezlikka o‘rta uchdan birda erishing.
Tiklanish uchun orqaga yurib qayting.

Bir maromda pedal aylantirish.

Qomatni tik tuting, qo‘llarni silkiting.

Oyoq uchlarida qoling.
Ovozsiz qo‘ning.

Ikki oyoqqa yumshoq qo‘ning, son orqada, tizzalar barmoqlar ustida.
Qo‘nish holatini 2 s ushlab turing.

lines: Bir oyoqdan ikkinchisiga yonga sakrang.
Keyingisidan oldin qo‘nib, 2 s qotib turing.
Masofani asta-sekin oshiring.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="127.6" y1="44.7" x2="121.3" y2="70.9" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="121.3" y1="70.9" x2="146" y2="60" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="88" x2="132.7" y2="123.8" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="132.7" y1="123.8" x2="108" y2="150" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="108" y1="150" x2="120" y2="150" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="88" x2="128.3" y2="40.7" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="130.2" cy="29.9" r="10"/><line x1="120" y1="88" x2="131.1" y2="124.4" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="131.1" y1="124.4" x2="126" y2="160" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="126" y1="160" x2="138" y2="160" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="127.6" y1="44.7" x2="125.6" y2="71.6" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="125.6" y1="71.6" x2="150" y2="60" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Yumshoq qo‘nib, 3 s ushlab turing.
Masofani oshiring, keyin yonga va diagonal sakrashlarni qo‘shing.

Rejali burilishlar 45° da, keyin 90° da.
Oxirida sherik signaliga javoban rejasiz burilishlar.

Qisqa richag: tizza skameykada. Uzun richag: to‘piq skameykada.
Sonni ko‘tarib ushlab turing, pastki oyoq erkin.

Qulay kuch bilan siqing.
Ushlab turing, keyin bo‘shating.

Bir tomonga o‘tib, o‘sha tizzani buking, ikkinchi oyoq to‘g‘ri.
O‘rtaga itarib qayting.

Chanoqni ostga bukib, orqa dumbani siqing.
Yumshoq oldinga siljing.

lines: Ikki oyoqda turing, tayanchni ushlang.
Oyoq uchlariga baland ko‘tariling.
3 s davomida sekin tushing.

Iloji boricha baland ko‘tariling.
3 s davomida tushiring.

Tizza bukikligini saqlab, oyoq uchiga ko‘tariling.
Sekin tushiring.

Holatni ushlab turing.
Sekin tushiring.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="118" y="160" width="52" height="16" rx="2"/><line x1="112" y1="50" x2="110.9" y2="77" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="110.9" y1="77" x2="114.8" y2="103.7" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="94" x2="134.2" y2="124.8" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="134.2" y1="124.8" x2="100" y2="136" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="136" x2="112" y2="136" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="94" x2="112" y2="46" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="112" cy="35" r="10"/><line x1="112" y1="94" x2="120.5" y2="131" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120.5" y1="131" x2="112" y2="166" class="near hl" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="166" x2="122.4" y2="160" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="50" x2="113.5" y2="77" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="113.5" y1="77" x2="119.9" y2="103.2" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Jarohatlangan oyoqqa o‘tib, tovonni 3 s davomida sekin tushiring.
Ko‘tarilish uchun ikkala oyoqdan foydalaning.

Rezinaga qarshi pastga bosing, yuqoriga torting, ichkariga va tashqariga buring.
Har yo‘nalishda sekin, nazoratli takrorlar.

title: To‘piq alifbosi
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="86.9" y1="123" x2="76.8" y2="148" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="76.8" y1="148" x2="78" y2="175" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="166" x2="133.6" y2="160.4" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="133.6" y1="160.4" x2="168" y2="171" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="168" y1="171" x2="168" y2="159" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="166" x2="86" y2="119" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="83.7" cy="108.3" r="10"/><line x1="96" y1="166" x2="134" y2="165.2" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="134" y1="165.2" x2="169.5" y2="170.9" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="169.5" y1="170.9" x2="173.6" y2="159.6" class="near hl" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="86.9" y1="123" x2="77.1" y2="148.2" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="77.1" y1="148.2" x2="80" y2="175" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Oyoqni poldan uzib o‘tiring.
Bosh barmoq bilan havoda alifbo harflarini chizing.
Tizzadan emas, to‘piqdan harakatlantiring.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="172" y="0" width="8" height="176"/><line x1="138.1" y1="76.4" x2="157.4" y2="95.3" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="157.4" y1="95.3" x2="174" y2="74" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="132" y1="120" x2="130.3" y2="158" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="130.3" y1="158" x2="96" y2="169" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="169" x2="106.4" y2="175" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="132" y1="120" x2="138.7" y2="72.5" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="140.2" cy="61.6" r="10"/><line x1="132" y1="120" x2="162.7" y2="142.3" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="162.7" y1="142.3" x2="150" y2="176" class="near hl" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="176" x2="162" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="138.1" y1="76.4" x2="159.3" y2="93.2" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="159.3" y1="93.2" x2="176" y2="72" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Devorga qarab turing, barmoqlar bir necha sm uzoqda.
Tovon polda, tizzani devorga tegizing.
Harakat yaxshilangan sari oyoqni orqaga suring.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="196" y="0" width="8" height="176"/><line x1="147.3" y1="63.9" x2="166.5" y2="82.9" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="166.5" y1="82.9" x2="192" y2="74" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124" y1="101.2" x2="108.4" y2="135.8" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="108.4" y1="135.8" x2="88.6" y2="165.9" class="far hl" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="88.6" y1="165.9" x2="100.6" y2="165.9" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124" y1="101.2" x2="149.4" y2="60.5" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="155.3" cy="51.2" r="10"/><line x1="124" y1="101.2" x2="139.6" y2="135.9" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="139.6" y1="135.9" x2="148.6" y2="170.7" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="148.6" y1="170.7" x2="160.6" y2="170.7" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="147.3" y1="63.9" x2="168.9" y2="80.1" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="168.9" y1="80.1" x2="194" y2="70" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Qo‘llar devorda, jarohatlangan oyoq orqada.
Orqa tovon polda, tizza to‘g‘ri.
Keyin kambalasimon mushakni cho‘zish uchun orqa tizzani buking.

Murakkablashtirish: ko‘z yumilgan → yostiq ustida → to‘p ushlab.
Tik turing.

title: Y-muvozanat cho‘zilishi
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="120.5" y1="79.2" x2="94.9" y2="70.5" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="94.9" y1="70.5" x2="86" y2="96" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="120" x2="137.3" y2="138.2" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="137.3" y1="138.2" x2="166.1" y2="159.9" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="166.1" y1="159.9" x2="177.9" y2="157.9" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="120" x2="122" y2="75.5" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="126.1" cy="65.3" r="10"/><line x1="104" y1="120" x2="133.8" y2="143.6" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="133.8" y1="143.6" x2="118" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="176" x2="130" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120.5" y1="79.2" x2="124.9" y2="105.8" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124.9" y1="105.8" x2="150" y2="96" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Ikkinchi oyoqni oldinga, orqa-chapga, orqa-o‘ngga iloji boricha uzoq cho‘zing.
Yengil tegizing, yiqilmasdan qayting.

Barmoqlar bo‘sh holda oyoq kaftining old qismini tovonga tortib, gumbazni ko‘taring.
Ushlab turing, keyin bo‘shating.

title: Sochiqni g‘ijimlash

Barmoqlarni bukib, sochiqni o‘zingizga torting.
Oxirida barmoqlarni keng yoying.

title: Plantar fassiyani cho‘zish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="62" y="138" width="36" height="6" rx="2"/><rect class="prop" x="62" y="94" width="5" height="82"/><rect class="prop" x="93" y="138" width="5" height="38"/><line x1="96" y1="90" x2="100.6" y2="116.6" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100.6" y1="116.6" x2="124" y2="130" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="134" x2="133.3" y2="141.2" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="133.3" y1="141.2" x2="124" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124" y1="176" x2="136" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="134" x2="96" y2="86" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="96" cy="75" r="10"/><line x1="96" y1="134" x2="121.8" y2="106.1" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="121.8" y1="106.1" x2="134" y2="140" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="134" y1="140" x2="129.5" y2="128.9" class="near hl" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="90" x2="113" y2="111" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="113" y1="111" x2="133.5" y2="128.5" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: O‘tirib, oyoqni ikkinchi tizza ustiga qo‘ying.
Barmoqlarni boldirga tomon orqaga torting.
Oyoq gumbazida cho‘zilishni his qiling.

title: Oyoq kaftini dumalatish

O‘rtacha bosim.
Tovondan barmoqlargacha.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="118" y1="49" x2="114.3" y2="75.7" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114.3" y1="75.7" x2="115.6" y2="102.7" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="93" x2="122.9" y2="130.7" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122.9" y1="130.7" x2="116" y2="166" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="166" x2="125.2" y2="173.7" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="93" x2="118" y2="45" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="118" cy="34" r="10"/><line x1="118" y1="93" x2="125.8" y2="130.2" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="125.8" y1="130.2" x2="122" y2="166" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="166" x2="131.2" y2="173.7" class="near hl" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="49" x2="116.9" y2="76" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116.9" y1="76" x2="120.7" y2="102.7" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><ellipse cx="131.2" cy="175.7" rx="8" ry="4" style="fill:var(--orange);opacity:.7"/></svg>
lines: Barmoqlar ostida o‘ralgan sochiq.
Bir oyoqda tovon ko‘tarish: 3 s yuqoriga, 2 s ushlab turish, 3 s pastga.
Oson bo‘lib qolganda kitobli ryukzak qo‘shing.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="66" y="0" width="8" height="176"/><line x1="80.4" y1="60.7" x2="93.3" y2="84.3" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="93.3" y1="84.3" x2="110.5" y2="105.2" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="88" y1="104" x2="109.3" y2="135.5" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="109.3" y1="135.5" x2="124.4" y2="168.2" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124.4" y1="168.2" x2="133.8" y2="160.8" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="88" y1="104" x2="79.7" y2="56.7" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="77.8" cy="45.9" r="10"/><line x1="88" y1="104" x2="110.6" y2="134.6" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="110.6" y1="134.6" x2="127.1" y2="166.5" class="near hl" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="127.1" y1="166.5" x2="136.6" y2="159.2" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="80.4" y1="60.7" x2="95.1" y2="83.3" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="95.1" y1="83.3" x2="113.5" y2="103" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Devorga suyaning, tovonlar 30 sm uzoqda.
Barmoqlar va oyoq kaftining old qismini boldirga tomon ko‘taring.
Sekin tushiring.

title: Mushuk–tuya
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="86.2" y1="122.4" x2="82" y2="149.1" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="82" y1="149.1" x2="84" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="128" y1="136" x2="130" y2="173.9" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="130" y1="173.9" x2="166" y2="174" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="166" y1="174" x2="178" y2="174" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M128 136 Q112.6 112.1 82.3 121.2" class="tor hl" stroke-width="10" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="71.5" cy="123.1" r="10"/><line x1="128" y1="136" x2="132" y2="173.8" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="132" y1="173.8" x2="168" y2="174" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="168" y1="174" x2="180" y2="174" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="86.2" y1="122.4" x2="82.8" y2="149.2" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="82.8" y1="149.2" x2="86" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Qo‘l va tizzalarda turing.
Belni sekin yuqoriga bukring, keyin yumshoq pastga tushiring.
Qulay chegarada harakatlaning.

title: «O‘lik qo‘ng‘iz»
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="76" y1="167" x2="51" y2="156.8" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="51" y1="156.8" x2="24" y2="156" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="120.3" y2="129" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120.3" y1="129" x2="156" y2="134" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="156" y1="134" x2="168" y2="134" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="72" y2="167" class="tor hl" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="61" cy="167" r="10"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="157.4" y2="160.1" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="157.4" y1="160.1" x2="193.4" y2="160" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="193.4" y1="160" x2="199.4" y2="149.6" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="76" y1="167" x2="86.6" y2="142.2" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="86.6" y1="142.2" x2="80" y2="116" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Chalqancha, qo‘llar yuqorida, son va tizzalar 90° da.
Qarama-qarshi qo‘l va oyoqni sekin tushiring.
Belni polga yumshoq bosib turing.

title: «Qush-it» mashqi
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="86.2" y1="122.4" x2="82" y2="149.1" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="82" y1="149.1" x2="84" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="128" y1="136" x2="165.3" y2="143.1" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="165.3" y1="143.1" x2="198" y2="128" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="198" y1="128" x2="200.1" y2="139.8" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="128" y1="136" x2="82.3" y2="121.2" class="tor hl" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="71.9" cy="117.8" r="10"/><line x1="128" y1="136" x2="132" y2="173.8" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="132" y1="173.8" x2="168" y2="174" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="168" y1="174" x2="180" y2="174" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="86.2" y1="122.4" x2="59.6" y2="117.5" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="59.6" y1="117.5" x2="32.6" y2="118" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Qo‘l va tizzalarda turing.
Qarama-qarshi qo‘l va oyoqni uzoqqa cho‘zing.
5–10 s ushlab turing, sonni burmang.

title: Makgill bo‘yicha tana ko‘tarish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="76.8" y1="158.6" x2="99" y2="174" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="99" y1="174" x2="126" y2="173" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="147.7" y2="141" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="147.7" y1="141" x2="156" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="156" y1="176" x2="168" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="72.9" y2="157.8" class="tor hl" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="61.9" cy="156.9" r="10"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="157.8" y2="163.3" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="157.8" y1="163.3" x2="193" y2="171" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="193" y1="171" x2="193" y2="159" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="76.8" y1="158.6" x2="92.4" y2="180.6" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="92.4" y1="180.6" x2="118" y2="172" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Chalqancha, bir tizza bukilgan, qo‘llar bel ostida.
Bosh va yelkalarni poldan biroz ko‘taring, bo‘yin qimirlamaydi.
8–10 s ushlab turing.

title: Yon planka
sub: Qiyshiq qorin mushaklari, tananing yon tomoni
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="78" y1="151.5" x2="90.7" y2="175.4" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="90.7" y1="175.4" x2="100" y2="150" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="150" x2="159.1" y2="158.3" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="159.1" y1="158.3" x2="192.3" y2="172.3" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="192.3" y1="172.3" x2="198.3" y2="161.9" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="150" x2="74" y2="151.7" class="tor hl" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="63" cy="152.1" r="10"/><line x1="122" y1="150" x2="159.3" y2="157.4" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="159.3" y1="157.4" x2="192.8" y2="170.5" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="192.8" y1="170.5" x2="198.8" y2="160.1" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="78" y1="151.5" x2="78" y2="175" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="78" y1="175" x2="50" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Yonboshlab, tirsak yelka ostida.
Avval tizzalar bukik, keyin to‘g‘ri oyoqlar.
Sonni bir chiziqqa ko‘tarib ushlab turing.

title: «Ochiq kitob»
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="68" y1="165" x2="93.6" y2="173.6" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="93.6" y1="173.6" x2="120" y2="168" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="150" y2="169" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="169" x2="128" y2="170" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="128" y1="170" x2="140" y2="170" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="64" y2="165" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="54" cy="160.4" r="10"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="152" y2="160" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="152" y1="160" x2="128" y2="166" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="128" y1="166" x2="140" y2="166" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="68" y1="165" x2="46.5" y2="148.7" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="46.5" y1="148.7" x2="19.7" y2="145.9" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Yonboshlab yoting, tizzalar bukilgan, qo‘llar oldinda birga.
Ustki qo‘lni ko‘z bilan kuzatib, boshqa tomonga oching.
Sekin qayting.

title: Girya bilan o‘lik tortish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="118" y1="59" x2="112.8" y2="85.5" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112.8" y1="85.5" x2="118" y2="112" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="122.9" y2="140.7" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122.9" y1="140.7" x2="116" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="176" x2="128" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="118" y2="55" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="118" cy="44" r="10"/><circle class="hlc" cx="118" cy="103" r="7"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="125.8" y2="140.2" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="125.8" y1="140.2" x2="122" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="176" x2="134" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="59" x2="115.2" y2="85.9" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="115.2" y1="85.9" x2="122" y2="112" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="116" y="114" width="12" height="11" rx="3" style="fill:var(--navy);opacity:.8"/></svg>
lines: Og‘irlik oyoqlar orasida.
Sondan bukiling, bel tekis, dastani ushlang.
Sonni oldinga itarib tik turing.

title: Chamadon ko‘tarib yurish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="118" y1="59" x2="113" y2="85.5" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="113" y1="85.5" x2="135.8" y2="100" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="115.1" y2="140.9" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="115.1" y1="140.9" x2="106.1" y2="175.7" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="106.1" y1="175.7" x2="118.1" y2="175.7" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="118" y2="55" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="118" cy="44" r="10"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="129.4" y2="139.3" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="129.4" y1="139.3" x2="133.9" y2="175" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="133.9" y1="175" x2="145.1" y2="179.1" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="59" x2="99.6" y2="78.7" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="99.6" y1="78.7" x2="116.2" y2="100" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="110.2" y="104" width="12" height="11" rx="3" style="fill:var(--navy);opacity:.8"/></svg>
lines: Bir qo‘lda og‘ir yuk ushlang.
Engashmasdan 20–30 m tik yuring.
Qo‘lni almashtiring.

title: Mayatnik
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="156" y="122" width="60" height="6" rx="2"/><rect class="prop" x="206" y="122" width="5" height="54"/><line x1="147.8" y1="90.4" x2="141.2" y2="116.6" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="141.2" y1="116.6" x2="168" y2="120" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="106" y1="104" x2="110.9" y2="141.7" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="110.9" y1="141.7" x2="100" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="176" x2="112" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="106" y1="104" x2="151.7" y2="89.2" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="162.1" cy="85.8" r="10"/><line x1="106" y1="104" x2="117.6" y2="140.2" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="117.6" y1="140.2" x2="114" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114" y1="176" x2="126" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="147.8" y1="90.4" x2="139.7" y2="116.2" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="139.7" y1="116.2" x2="137.1" y2="143" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Bir qo‘lni stolga qo‘yib oldinga egiling.
Og‘riyotgan qo‘lni erkin osiltirib qo‘ying.
Tanani tebratib kichik aylanalar hosil qiling.

Ikkinchi qo‘l bilan bilakni yumshoq pastga buking.
Ushlab turing.

lines: Qo‘llar yelkalar ostida, tana to‘g‘ri chiziqda (osonlashtirish uchun tizzalarda).
Ko‘krakni polga tomon tushiring.
Son osilib tushmasdan orqaga itarib ko‘tariling.

lines: Bilaklar polda, tirsaklar yelkalar ostida.
Boshdan tovongacha to‘g‘ri chiziq hosil qilib ko‘tariling.
Ushlab turing va nafas oling.

lines: Yuz bilan pastga yoting, qo‘llar bosh ustida.
Qo‘llar, ko‘krak va oyoqlarni poldan biroz ko‘taring.
3 s ushlab turing, sekin tushiring.

title: Yulduzcha sakrash

lines: Tik turing, qo‘llar yon tomonda.
Qo‘llarni boshdan yuqoriga ko‘targan holda oyoqlarni keng ochib sakrang.
Sakrab yana birlashtiring.

title: Joyida qadam tashlash
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="118" y1="59" x2="107.8" y2="84" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="107.8" y1="84" x2="129.5" y2="100" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="122.3" y2="140.8" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122.3" y1="140.8" x2="115" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="115" y1="176" x2="127" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="118" y2="55" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="118" cy="44" r="10"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="126.5" y2="140" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="126.5" y1="140" x2="125" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="125" y1="176" x2="136.3" y2="180.1" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="59" x2="102.9" y2="81.4" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="102.9" y1="81.4" x2="122.5" y2="100" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Tik turing.
Bir tizzani son balandligigacha ko‘taring, so‘ng ikkinchisini.
Qo‘llarni silkiting.

title: Orqaga hamla
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="114" y1="96" x2="112.2" y2="122.9" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112.2" y1="122.9" x2="116" y2="149.7" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114" y1="140" x2="105.1" y2="176.9" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="105.1" y1="176.9" x2="70" y2="169" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="70" y1="169" x2="79.8" y2="175.9" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114" y1="140" x2="114" y2="92" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="114" cy="81" r="10"/><line x1="114" y1="140" x2="151.6" y2="145.8" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="151.6" y1="145.8" x2="132" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="132" y1="176" x2="144" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114" y1="96" x2="114.1" y2="123" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114.1" y1="123" x2="119.9" y2="149.4" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Bir oyoqni orqaga qo‘yib, orqa tizzani polga tomon tushiring.
Old tovon bilan itarib qayting.

Oldinga engashib, qo‘llardan foydalanmasdan turing.
Sekin qayta o‘tiring.

lines: Baland planka holati, qo‘llar yelkalar ostida.
Bir tizzani ko‘krakka torting, keyin almashtiring.
Son past va barqaror bo‘lsin.

lines: Tik o‘tiring yoki turing.
Boshni sekin pastga va yuqoriga egib, keyin chapga va o‘ngga buring.
Qulay oraliqda harakatlaning.

Ko‘krak cho‘zilishi sezilguncha yumshoq oldinga qadam qo‘ying.
Ushlab turing, keyin tomonni almashtiring.

title: Son orqasini cho‘zish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="76" y1="167" x2="100" y2="179.3" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="179.3" x2="126" y2="172" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="157.9" y2="164.8" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="157.9" y1="164.8" x2="193" y2="173" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="193" y1="173" x2="193" y2="161" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="72" y2="167" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="61" cy="167" r="10"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="131.2" y2="130.7" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="131.2" y1="130.7" x2="150" y2="100" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="100" x2="138.2" y2="97.9" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="76" y1="167" x2="96.1" y2="149" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96.1" y1="149" x2="113.3" y2="128.2" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line class="band" x1="113.3" y1="128.2" x2="138.2" y2="97.9" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg>
lines: Chalqancha yoting, bir oyoq kaftiga sochiq ilingan.
Cho‘zilish sezilguncha to‘g‘ri oyoqni ko‘taring.
Oyoqni bo‘shashtirib ushlab turing.

title: Qo‘llarni aylantirish

Avval oldinga, so‘ng orqaga sekin doira chizing.
Doiralarni asta-sekin kattalashtiring.

Qutiga yengil tekkuncha sekin orqaga o‘tiring.
O‘sha oyoqda turing, tizza 2-barmoq yo‘nalishida.

title: Rezina bilan yonga yurish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="122" y1="66" x2="104.1" y2="86.2" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104.1" y1="86.2" x2="112" y2="112" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="110" x2="122.6" y2="148" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122.6" y1="148" x2="100" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100" y1="176" x2="112" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="110" x2="122" y2="62" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="122" cy="51" r="10"/><circle class="hlc" cx="122" cy="110" r="7"/><line x1="122" y1="110" x2="145.2" y2="140.1" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="145.2" y1="140.1" x2="148" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="148" y1="176" x2="160" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="66" x2="108.9" y2="89.6" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="108.9" y1="89.6" x2="124" y2="112" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line class="band" x1="145.2" y1="140.1" x2="122.6" y2="148" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg>

Rezina tarangligini saqlab, yonga qadam tashlang.
Bir tomonga 10 qadam, keyin orqaga.

title: O‘tirib tizzani yozish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="prop" x="62" y="138" width="36" height="6" rx="2"/><rect class="prop" x="62" y="94" width="5" height="82"/><rect class="prop" x="93" y="138" width="5" height="38"/><line x1="96" y1="90" x2="100.6" y2="116.6" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="100.6" y1="116.6" x2="124" y2="130" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="134" x2="133.3" y2="141.2" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="133.3" y1="141.2" x2="124" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124" y1="176" x2="136" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="134" x2="96" y2="86" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="96" cy="75" r="10"/><line x1="96" y1="134" x2="131.1" y2="119.3" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="131.1" y1="119.3" x2="166" y2="128" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="166" y1="128" x2="166" y2="116" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="96" y1="90" x2="105.3" y2="115.3" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="105.3" y1="115.3" x2="128" y2="130" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Stulda tik o‘tiring.
Bir tizzani to‘liq to‘g‘rilab, sonni 2 s siqing.
Sekin tushiring.

title: Tovonda yurish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="119.5" y1="59" x2="114.4" y2="85.5" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114.4" y1="85.5" x2="137.2" y2="100" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="114.1" y2="140.8" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114.1" y1="140.8" x2="104.2" y2="175.4" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104.2" y1="175.4" x2="114" y2="168.5" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="119.7" y2="55" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="120.1" cy="44" r="10"/><line x1="118" y1="103" x2="130.3" y2="139" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="130.3" y1="139" x2="135.8" y2="174.5" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="135.8" y1="174.5" x2="145.6" y2="167.7" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="119.5" y1="59" x2="99.9" y2="77.5" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="99.9" y1="77.5" x2="114.8" y2="100" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Barmoqlarni ko‘tarib, tovonda yuring.
Tizzalar to‘g‘ri, tik turing.
10–20 m yuring.

title: Oyoq uchida yurish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="119.5" y1="50" x2="123.5" y2="76.7" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="123.5" y1="76.7" x2="137.2" y2="100" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="94" x2="114.1" y2="131.8" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114.1" y1="131.8" x2="104.2" y2="166.4" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104.2" y1="166.4" x2="113.4" y2="174.1" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="94" x2="119.7" y2="46" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="120.1" cy="35" r="10"/><line x1="118" y1="94" x2="130.3" y2="130" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="130.3" y1="130" x2="135.8" y2="165.5" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="135.8" y1="165.5" x2="145" y2="173.3" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="119.5" y1="50" x2="107.3" y2="74.1" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="107.3" y1="74.1" x2="114.8" y2="100" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Oyoq uchlariga baland ko‘tariling.
Tovonlarni tushirmasdan oldinga yuring.
10–20 m yuring.

title: Yonboshlab yotib son oldini cho‘zish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="68" y1="166.2" x2="93.8" y2="174.3" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="93.8" y1="174.3" x2="120" y2="168" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="166.2" x2="150" y2="165.3" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="165.3" x2="185.6" y2="170.9" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="185.6" y1="170.9" x2="191.6" y2="160.5" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="166.2" x2="64" y2="166.2" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="53" cy="166.2" r="10"/><line x1="112" y1="166.2" x2="152" y2="158" class="near hl" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="152" y1="158" x2="118" y2="140" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="140" x2="112" y2="129.6" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="68" y1="166.2" x2="92.9" y2="155.8" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="92.9" y1="155.8" x2="115.2" y2="140.6" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Yonboshlab yoting.
Ustki tizzani bukib, to‘piqni ushlang.
Tizzalarni birga tutib, tovonni dumbaga torting.

title: Iyakni ichkariga tortish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="116" y1="59" x2="110.8" y2="85.5" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="110.8" y1="85.5" x2="116" y2="112" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="103" x2="122.1" y2="140.5" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122.1" y1="140.5" x2="116" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="176" x2="128" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="103" x2="116" y2="55" class="tor hl" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="114.1" cy="44.2" r="10"/><line x1="116" y1="103" x2="124.3" y2="140.1" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124.3" y1="140.1" x2="122" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="176" x2="134" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="59" x2="114.8" y2="86" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="114.8" y1="86" x2="122" y2="112" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Tik o‘tiring yoki turing, ko‘z to‘g‘riga qaragan.
Iyakni to‘g‘ri orqaga suring («ikki iyak» hosil qiling).
5 s ushlab turing, bo‘shating.

title: Bo‘yin izometriyasi
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="118" y1="60.2" x2="109.4" y2="85.8" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="109.4" y1="85.8" x2="116" y2="112" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="104.2" x2="125.9" y2="141.4" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="125.9" y1="141.4" x2="116" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="176" x2="128" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="104.2" x2="118" y2="56.2" class="tor hl" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="118" cy="45.2" r="10"/><line x1="118" y1="104.2" x2="128.8" y2="140.6" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="128.8" y1="140.6" x2="122" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="176" x2="134" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="118" y1="60.2" x2="142" y2="60" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="142" y1="60" x2="130" y2="40" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Kaftingizni boshning yon tomoniga qo‘ying.
Boshni qimirlatmasdan qo‘lga yumshoq bosing.
5–10 s ushlab turing. Old, orqa va ikki yon tomonda takrorlang.

title: Engashib tortish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="142.8" y1="87.3" x2="116.1" y2="91" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116.1" y1="91" x2="116" y2="118" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="108" x2="123.3" y2="140.7" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="123.3" y1="140.7" x2="116" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116" y1="176" x2="128" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104" y1="108" x2="146.4" y2="85.5" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="156.1" cy="80.3" r="10"/><line x1="104" y1="108" x2="124.4" y2="140.1" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124.4" y1="140.1" x2="122" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="122" y1="176" x2="134" y2="176" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="142.8" y1="87.3" x2="116.1" y2="91.3" class="near hl" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="116.1" y1="91.3" x2="120" y2="118" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="114" y="114" width="12" height="11" rx="3" style="fill:var(--navy);opacity:.8"/></svg>
lines: Bel tekis holda oldinga engashing, qo‘lda gantel yoki rezina.
Tirsaklarni orqaga torting, kuraklarni siqing.
Sekin tushiring.

title: Qorinda yotib T va Y ko‘tarish
sub: Trapetsiya mushagining pastki va o‘rta qismi
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="76" y1="167" x2="51.5" y2="155.7" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="51.5" y1="155.7" x2="25.3" y2="149.3" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="158" y2="166.7" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="158" y1="166.7" x2="193.5" y2="172.9" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="193.5" y1="172.9" x2="197.6" y2="184.2" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="72" y2="167" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="61" cy="167" r="10"/><line x1="120" y1="167" x2="158" y2="165.7" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="158" y1="165.7" x2="193.6" y2="170.9" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="193.6" y1="170.9" x2="197.7" y2="182.2" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="76" y1="167" x2="52" y2="154.6" class="near hl" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="52" y1="154.6" x2="26.1" y2="147.2" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
lines: Skameyka yoki polda yuz bilan pastga yoting.
Qo‘llarni «T» shaklida yonga, keyin «Y» shaklida yuqoriga ko‘taring, bosh barmoqlar yuqorida.
Sekin tushiring.

title: Yonboshlab yotib tashqariga burish
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="68" y1="165" x2="93.6" y2="173.6" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="93.6" y1="173.6" x2="120" y2="168" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="150" y2="164.7" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="164.7" x2="185.5" y2="170.9" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="185.5" y1="170.9" x2="191.5" y2="160.5" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="64" y2="165" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="53" cy="165" r="10"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="146" y2="150" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="146" y1="150" x2="150" y2="168" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="150" y1="168" x2="162" y2="168" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="68" y1="165" x2="98" y2="150" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="98" y1="150" x2="104" y2="124" class="near hl" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="98" y="120" width="12" height="11" rx="3" style="fill:var(--navy);opacity:.8"/></svg>
lines: Yonboshlab yoting, ustki tirsak ostida sochiq, tirsak 90° bukilgan.
Bilakni shiftga tomon yuqoriga buring.
3 s davomida sekin tushing.

Son polda qolgan holda ko‘krakni yuqoriga itaring.
Bo‘shashib tushing.

Bir tizzani ikki qo‘l bilan ko‘krakka torting.
Ushlab turing, keyin almashtiring.

Qo‘llarni polda oldinga cho‘zing.
Bo‘shashing va belga nafas oling.

Rezinani ko‘krakda ushlab, to‘g‘ri oldinga itaring.
Burilmasdan 2 s ushlab turing, qaytaring.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="85.2" y1="165.7" x2="102.5" y2="186.3" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="102.5" y1="186.3" x2="126" y2="173" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124" y1="145" x2="161.7" y2="140.5" class="far" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="161.7" y1="140.5" x2="156" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="156" y1="176" x2="168" y2="176" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124" y1="145" x2="81.6" y2="167.5" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="71.9" cy="172.7" r="10"/><circle class="hlc" cx="124" cy="145" r="7"/><line x1="124" y1="145" x2="143" y2="112.1" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="143" y1="112.1" x2="168" y2="138" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="168" y1="138" x2="177.2" y2="130.3" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="85.2" y1="165.7" x2="104.2" y2="184.8" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="104.2" y1="184.8" x2="128" y2="172" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

Bir oyoqni poldan biroz uzing, keyin ikkinchisini.
Butun vaqt son tekis bo‘lsin.

svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 190" class="rig"><line class="gnd" x1="0" y1="177" x2="240" y2="177" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="68" y1="165" x2="93.6" y2="173.6" class="far" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="93.6" y1="173.6" x2="120" y2="168" class="far" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="146" y2="148" class="far hl" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="146" y1="148" x2="182" y2="148" class="far" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="182" y1="148" x2="188" y2="137.6" class="far" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="64" y2="165" class="tor" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle class="head" cx="53" cy="165" r="10"/><line x1="112" y1="165" x2="148" y2="140" class="near" stroke-width="8.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="148" y1="140" x2="124" y2="168" class="near" stroke-width="7.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="124" y1="168" x2="136" y2="168" class="near" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="68" y1="165" x2="71.9" y2="138.3" class="near" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="71.9" y1="138.3" x2="46" y2="146" class="near" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

To‘g‘ri pastki oyoqni poldan yuqoriga ko‘taring.
Sekin tushiring.
